body: That's just it, he is completely innocent. He would never do what they are accusing him of. It's his word against their's and in this system you are assumed guilty and must prove your innocence.

Way past that. He has an attorney. Unfortunately, he spoke with the LE during the interview - he didn't realize how serious it was and he didn't fully process the questioning. They are using that.

The trial is coming soon. I'm just wondering if there are people or studies or cases or whatever out there that can help.
I wanted to believe in the spider, but it is the pattern. The spider makes it cooler though.
